references.text: Abraham laughs when God tells him that Sarah will bear a son, which reflects doubt or surprise at the possibility of having a child in their old age.
Sarah becomes pregnant and bears a son to Abraham in his old age, fulfilling God's promise.
It is mentioned that Sarah was barren, which highlights the miracle of her later pregnancy.
Paul refers to Abraham's faith in God's promise of a son despite his and Sarah's advanced age.
Sarah herself received power to conceive and gave birth to a child when she was past the age of childbearing, because she considered him faithful who had made the promise.
